verdict.rationale: Luma documents its own API, with generation endpoints, SDKs and API keys. Several UI generation features are explicitly exposed through it: text/image/video-to-video, 16-keyframe control ("exposed at the API"), HDR/EXR export, and FAQ references to outpaint, extend and interpolate. However, nothing shows that the browser workspace's Luma Agents, Skills workflows, Modify Video V2, motion/camera transfer, or account/asset management are reachable programmatically, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: evidence of API access to Agents/Skills workflows, Modify Video/motion-transfer/relighting features, account and asset management parity, a published machine-readable API spec, independent confirmation of UI–API parity.
